acceptance.thresholds_status: calibrated from six archived 10-day baseline fits before any 40-day fit

access_policy.confirmation: One opening after complete recipe and thresholds freeze
access_policy.locked: One opening after confirmation passes without recipe changes

research_a.measurement: Synchronized CUDA; same full input keys; warmup excluded; shared preprocessing reported separately

research_b.measurement: Synchronized CUDA; same full input keys; warmup excluded; shared preprocessing reported separately

calibration.basis: Six archived 10-day baseline fits on research_a/research_b, re-scored from their frozen predictions and evaluation targets; frozen before any 40-day fit.

fit_policy: Once per origin, arm and prescribed seed; fixed weights afterward; no score-based retries.
hypothesis: Expanding training dates from 10 to 40 reduces recent-window sensitivity and improves subsequent ranking and long-short stability.

literature.restriction: Classification scores do not establish returns; no causal weight-age claim.

basis.rss_formula: round_up_256(1.25 x measured peak host RSS)
basis.wall_formula: round_up_300(1.25 x (measured preprocessing + 1500 x measured seconds/step) + 300s save/check slack)

policy.exposure_policy: Steps, batch size, learning rate and recipe stay fixed for this round; a larger pool gets no extra steps because that would confound coverage with compute.
policy.interpretation_rule: A non-accept result bounds what equal-compute date expansion achieves; it does not establish that more history is uninformative.
policy.primary_metric: paired daily all-eight-time RankIC, seed-mean per day before pairing

statistics.sensitivity_rule: Report both block lengths; conflicting conclusions are inconclusive, and neither is chosen after seeing results.

purge_policy: Source label_end preferred; endpoint < training cutoff; frozen date membership. Without label_end, official no-overnight labels are conservatively bounded by same-day 15:00, strictly before the midnight cutoff. Existing intraday selection clock (11:30 -> 13:30) remains an unverified assumption, not actual endpoint verification.

supersedes.reason: Adds the measured executable budget (peak host memory, wall time, exact pool-sized sample caps) and the baseline-only decision gates required before any 40-day fit.

conventions.correlation_comparison: each policy correlation requires all target-eligible timestamps; incomplete baseline or absent evidence is inconclusive; incomplete candidate rejected
conventions.costs: gross forward label returns; no fees, execution, overlap or compounding adjustment
conventions.cross_section: one prediction timestamp; average ranks for ties
conventions.daily: equal timestamp mean; undefined correlations remain missing and are counted
conventions.extreme_return: mean of worst ceil(1% * days) daily long-short returns
conventions.long_short_sharpe: daily mean / sample std * sqrt(periods_per_year); zero variance undefined
conventions.official_score: not implemented: official complete evaluation rules unavailable
conventions.portfolio: equal tail weights; floor(n*quantile), minimum one; boundary ties share weight
conventions.rank_ic_ir: daily mean / sample std (ddof=1), not annualized
conventions.signal_change: mean absolute raw score change and rank correlation on common stocks; first timestamp undefined; consecutive sampled timestamps, including overnight
